title: media.processed v1 payload
description: The media is ready to serve. Recorded once per media, in the same transaction that marks it ready (a replayed step records nothing). For a transcoded video (5.2, additive fields): purpose, the HLS renditions made (short side in px, never above the source), duration and the top rendition's size; variants then lists poster, hls and mp4 (when the MP4 fallback is on).
